revision_note: Aligned with the 57-project OSS static review, the landed P0/P1/P2 implementations of 2026-10-22/23 and harness v0.8 priority S6>S4>S2>S5>S7>S3>S8>S1. Phase counts now price remaining hardening/integration only; landed capabilities are baselines, not re-estimated. Added survey-finding-to-acceptance mapping and an explicit licensing-review package.

calendar_assumption.note: Calendar duration is constrained by platform interfaces, security review, test tenants, billing owners and QPU windows; it is not total_person_days divided by headcount.

included: DSH as the only production Agent Runtime
Existing company-local models and DeepSeek: remaining integration, isolation and data-boundary acceptance
Existing mature cloud and HPC identity, job, result, quota and billing interfaces
Internal and external accounts, tenant isolation, enterprise service enablement, delegated credentials and approval
Three-column web and local workspace with shared server-side facts
Managed general-purpose Agent capabilities through providers, plugins, MCP and Skills
Bounded QASM upload, simulator, compilation, algorithm.catalog/component_id integration
HPC workflow, one supervised QPU provider, reconciliation and unknown semantics
Result assets, analysis and plot templates, governed knowledge and Skills content
Security, licensing review, reliability, performance, billing reconciliation, support and pilot release
excluded: Base-model training or large-scale inference infrastructure
New cloud platform, enterprise identity system, HPC scheduler, QPU control system or accounting ledger
New quantum algorithm, decoder, optimizer or ion-scheduling research
Unattended device calibration or approval bypass
Unlimited company-wide knowledge curation and historical data cleanup
A second Agent Runtime or a general-purpose shell preset that bypasses policy
Unbounded procurement, legal, vendor and platform-owner waiting time

reconciliation_with_prior_estimate.note: That estimate covers only the quantum-workspace subset. This 2000 person-day plan keeps it as the core (mainly P4/P5) and prices the remaining commercial scope: general Agent productization, enterprise identity/tenants, three-column web/local UI, operations/billing, security acceptance and release handover.

investment_priority: S6 governance > S4 execution isolation > S2 context > S5 state/memory > S7 validation > S3 tools > S8 interface > S1 model acceptance
invariants: DSH remains the only Agent Runtime; no new model/session/tool loop
Algorithms come only from platform algorithm.catalog and component_id
Business handles are asset_id, circuit_id and twin_id only
Only quantum_device_run with ionstack-twinrun may return twin_id
quantum_device_run is ask in lab/sign and deny in boot/algo
Unknown tools, presets, providers, envelopes and states fail closed
Platform facts are authoritative for acceptance, completion, cancellation, billing and unknown outcomes
No automatic device retry; request_id is not assumed to be an idempotency key
Tool results stay short; scientific bodies, credentials, CAL, shuttle, bitstrings and Pauli stay in governed platform assets

phases.exit: Provider identity, initial capability set, account boundary, acceptance tuple and risk register are frozen.

phases.name: Identity, tenant, service enablement and authorization
phases.exit: Two tenants demonstrate independent login, enablement, credential injection, tool visibility, authorization and probe status; demo-global plan state upgraded to per-user binding.

phases.name: DSH, local model, plugin, MCP and Skills productization
phases.exit: Remaining runtime hardening only; per-transport MCP gates cover STDIO lacking OAuth; no silent external model fallback.

phases.name: Managed general-purpose Agent capability
phases.exit: Controlled file, code, web and document workflows work; unscanned web content is marked unverified; no second runtime or shell bypass.

phases.name: Quantum, cloud and HPC job adapters
phases.exit: One simulator, one HPC flow and one supervised QPU flow close the narrow end-to-end loop with platform-truth reconciliation.

phases.name: Results, analysis, Canvas, knowledge and Skills content
phases.exit: Templates build on the two landed ones; the 64000-byte result contract is enforced, never silently truncated.

phases.name: Three-column web, local UI and workbench
phases.exit: Web and local UI consume the same server-side facts and remain queryable after chat disconnect.

phases.name: Billing, quotas, operations and support
phases.exit: Model, HPC, QPU and enterprise billing dimensions are reconciled separately; audit fields are company-owned, not trace substitutes.

phases.name: Security, licensing, reliability and commercial acceptance
phases.exit: Security, tenant isolation, fault recovery, capacity, licensing review and representative platform evidence are complete.

phases.name: Release, pilot, documentation and handover
phases.exit: Pilot is rollback-capable, supportable and has complete version and acceptance evidence.

survey_alignment.finding: Docker MCP Gateway returns all-allow NoopClient outside Desktop or when the governance flag is unavailable (H23)
survey_alignment.plan_item: P8 policy gates; P2 plugin onboarding
survey_alignment.acceptance: Governance component failure must refuse execution; company policy enforced before invoke.

survey_alignment.finding: Firecrawl injection guard is opt-in and fails open on classifier errors or oversized pages (H40)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Unscanned content is marked unverified and never auto-executed.

survey_alignment.finding: FastMCP documents that STDIO transport skips OAuth checks (H16)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Per-transport tests: host process boundary plus company authorization.

survey_alignment.finding: Ollama chat route trims history and has cloud/remote model branches (H50)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Context trimming must not remove approval/parameter grounding; local deployment is not offline by default.

survey_alignment.finding: Inspect truncates tool output at 16KB while company contract allows 64000 bytes and forbids lossy truncation (H42, docs/oss-survey/03)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Templates honor the 64000-byte contract; overflow becomes platform asset references.

survey_alignment.finding: CopilotKit runs per-thread clone instances; run events are frontend semantics (H48)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Subscriptions bind to the actual session instance; run completion is not a platform terminal state.

survey_alignment.finding: Langfuse authentication Session differs from business TraceSession; ReplacingMergeTree is not an immutable ledger (H54)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Audit fields are company-owned; traces never serve as billing or compliance vouchers.

survey_alignment.finding: Phoenix root is ELv2 while packages/phoenix-otel is Apache-2.0 (H55)
survey_alignment.acceptance: License registered per adoption scope, not per repository.

survey_alignment.finding: LiteLLM budget hooks cover model-token scope only (H53)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Model tokens, HPC node-hours, QPU usage and enterprise billing are separate ledgers.

survey_alignment.finding: open-swe database event claims do not provide external exactly-once (H15)
survey_alignment.acceptance: unknown follows platform facts; request_id is not an idempotency key.

survey_alignment.finding: Aider repo ranking grants no read permission (H07); Repomix reads the whole file before the size check (H39)
survey_alignment.plan_item: P5 knowledge retrieval; P3 context budget
survey_alignment.acceptance: Tenant filtering precedes retrieval; explicit read paths and byte budgets for code context.

survey_alignment.finding: Goose proves revoked grants must not come back (H03); gptme defaults to confirm without hooks (H02)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Revocation is immediate with cross-instance counterexamples; no-confirm paths default to deny.

survey_alignment.finding: SWE-bench rejects zero-execution and contradictory exit-code logs (H43)
survey_alignment.acceptance: Success requires real execution evidence; not-run or all-skipped suites never pass.

gates.name: Limited production
criteria: At least one internal and one external tenant

first_10_working_days: Confirm Agent provider identity and Uniqon identity for the selected versions
Obtain non-sensitive cloud/HPC/QPU API contracts, state enums, cursors, cancellation, business references and test tenants
Obtain local DeepSeek model identifiers, DSH/OpenAI-compatible protocol, tool-call, SSE, structured-output and rate-limit information
Run two tenants, one simulator, one HPC job, one QASM, one denial and one unknown recovery without real device execution
Release or retain risk reserve based on measured findings and update the estimate
